profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer building secure, scalable cloud and web applications with C#/.NET and modern JavaScript frameworks. Focused on API design, automation, DevOps, and cloud architecture across Azure and AWS. Lead engineering standards in documentation, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to streamline delivery, improve reliability, and accelerate onboarding.

Skilled in developing APIs, integrating cloud services, and applying automation to improve developer efficiency and system resilience. Passionate about maintainable architecture, clear documentation, and practical adoption of modern tools and AI-assisted workflows. Committed to delivering reliable, well-structured solutions that support long-term scalability and continuous improvement.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Leading development of the team’s first cloud-native Azure application automating Data Subject Access Requests (DSAR), eliminating manual engineer intervention. Driving architecture, security, and CI/CD design while guiding a small team through development, testing, and deployment to establish cloud-first standards for future migrations.

Defined security baselines, secret-management practices, and deployment standards for Azure-hosted services. Piloted Bicep templates for infrastructure-as-code (IaC) to deploy and manage Azure resources consistently and securely. Led AI adoption within the team—evaluating emerging tools, integrating them into workflows, and sharing best practices to improve productivity and code quality.

Designed and implemented a new API gateway that streamlined communication between a vendor application and internal API, enabling deprecation of a legacy monolith and improving efficiency for critical business operations. Strengthened security infrastructure by integrating Azure Key Vault, patching outdated dependencies, and enhancing logging for faster troubleshooting.

Provided on-call support for applications and executed DSARs using SQL scripts to ensure compliance with privacy regulations. Tracked requests through ServiceNow and managed production releases via documented change requests.

Initiated and led a project to standardize README documentation across repositories—researching best practices, proposing a standard, and guiding rollout for consistent adoption. Authored detailed release and branching documentation with validation checklists. Provided mentorship and code reviews to improve reliability and knowledge sharing.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Information Services (IIS) · Microsoft Azure · GitHub · React.js · Microsoft SQL Server · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Agile Methodologies · JSON · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Unit Testing · Programming · REST APIs · Software Development · xUnit · C# · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Git

positions.title: Full Stack .NET Developer II
positions.description:
Built account-management features in Angular 13 and .NET 6 to replace a legacy site and expand functionality for accounts, stores, and notifications. Implemented backend API controllers supporting new Angular components.

Created custom Azure AD B2C policies with SendGrid integration for custom verification emails and one-time passcodes. Authored HTML content for policies and hosted it in Azure Storage. Added Azure Key Vault for secure secret management and modified IIS-hosted APIs to authenticate with Azure.

Delivered a secure Umbraco CMS-integrated API for content retrieval and display across multiple web apps. Developed and updated stored procedures in SQL Server, extended API endpoints to consume them, and surfaced the results in the frontend.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to multiple web apps using Angular or React with TypeScript on the frontend and C#/.NET on the backend, hosted on AWS using REST APIs for communication. Built a loan-document retrieval app that orchestrated service calls, merged documents into PDFs, and uploaded them to S3 for audits.

Built an internal app generator (Angular + C#) that let engineers select templates and input project info to auto-generate a starter project with AWS infrastructure, a new GitHub repo, and a CircleCI pipeline—standardizing best practices and reducing setup time.

Maintained a company-wide app catalog by fixing bugs, adding dashboards for project lifecycle tracking, and helping migrate from AngularJS to Angular. Created a React + TypeScript SPA to centralize tools and documentation.

Authored and maintained CI/CD pipelines in CircleCI and GitHub Actions for dependency scanning, testing, and deployments to AWS ECS, EC2, and S3. Migrated projects to .NET 6 and modernized internal libraries. Practiced TDD with xUnit and Jest, performed code reviews, and worked with AWS services including S3, ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, and Lambda within Scrum ceremonies.

positions.title: Senior Desktop Support Technician
positions.description: Responsible for day-to-day technology support at Rocket Mortgage and the family of companies.  Worked closely with Helpdesk, Telecom, and other 3rd level engineering teams to ensure all systems and teams are working.  Assisted and mentored Helpdesk and other Desktop Technicians.  Provided onsite hands-on desktop services for hardware and software including install/move/add/change.  Imaged, deployed, and managed new desktops and laptops.  Reconfigured and re-purposed older machines, and set up workstations for new employees.  Participated in IT projects and physical moves.  Documented issue details, troubleshooting steps, resolution, and root cause utilizing ticketing system.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Managed account migrations from legacy network tools and support into the new standard support models and tools.  This included assessing client network device to standards, getting approval to migrate the account, setting up meetings to create a migration schedule and ensuring that all teams involved in the migration completed their assigned tasks.

positions.title: Geek Squad
positions.description: Interacted professionally with many different types of clients to help solve the problems they had with their PC, Mac, or Tablet.  Troubleshoot issues clients had with their phone, printer, camera or other technology.  Troubleshoot and diagnose sophisticated issues as required and develop effective solutions to the identified problems.  Communicated to the client what services will performed, the benefit of having those services performed, and how to avoid future issues.  Logged, prioritized, and updated the status of all work as client issues were resolved.  Additionally, determined whether to escalate the issue to the regional service center or solve it within the Geek Squad.

projects.title: Gallery Designer
projects.description:
Gallery Designer is a free, open-source web app for planning gallery walls to scale.

Build continuous walls, including connected sections and corners; add artwork with exact dimensions and hanging hardware; arrange pieces manually or with automatic placement; and account for furniture and wall features.

Everything runs in your browser, with no account, backend server, or uploads required.

Your work autosaves in browser storage. Create, rename, duplicate, and switch between multiple designs as you work. Export PNG or PDF installation plans with measurements, or export JSON to back up the current design.

Built with React and TypeScript, Vitest unit/component coverage, Playwright browser testing, and automated GitHub Pages deployment.
